summary: The RTX PRO 6000 hardware profile sets TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0a
compatibility: No user action required; no current component compiles CUDA through torch cpp_extension at runtime.
details: Replaces the NGC base image's multi-architecture list (7.5 to 12.0+PTX) on this hardware, matching CUTE_DSL_ARCH=sm_120a. Other hardware keeps the image value.
